Allow & Continue Location Permission Needed We use your location to record Start Work and End Work activities.\n • Your location is captured only when you tap Start or End Work to:\n\n • Verify that you have reached the assigned work site\n • Record accurate attendance time\n • Calculate travel distance for reimbursement\n • Your location is not tracked continuously and is not collected when the app is closed. Share Current Location
We use your current location to help your organization set the office location during account creation.\n This location will be shared with your organization to:\n\n • Save the official office address\n • Enable attendance marking within a 500-meter range of the office.\n • Your location is captured only when you tap “Get Current Location”.\n • We do not track your location continuously and do not collect it in the background.\n • Ensure your safety while on field assignments\n
